Subject: Your breach of contract matter (Project Kestrel)

Dear Ms. Mittal,

Thank you for meeting us on 12 July 2022 about your dispute with M/s Coastal Logistics Ltd. As we understand it, the counterparty has not paid the invoices for delivered goods.

Our advice is to invoke the arbitration clause and seek interim relief to secure the amount. Please collect the contract, the invoices and the delivery challans and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs. 8,23,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
